dynamics.exact_update: x_{t+1} = A_kappa x_t + b_j u_t + eta_t
dynamics.decomposition: F(x)=A_0 x; R(x,K)=-h Q_K x; A_kappa=I+h(-Q_0+Omega-kappa Q_K)

K.definition: K = {x in R^4 : c1=0 and c2=0}

process_noise.generation: SHA256 counter-mode uniforms followed by the frozen Box-Muller transform in rng_contract

restoring_potential.interpretation: registered conservative restoring curvature only; not the full dynamical Jacobian

theta.fixed_C_entries: all C entries other than c13 and c24 are fixed exactly as C_nominal
theta.fisher_expectation: uniform over 16 intervention cells, registered post-signature times, and the registered seed distribution at each kappa

intervention_contract.injection_rule: u_t = amplitude * p(t-256); x_{t+1} receives target_vector * u_t
intervention_contract.matching_requirement: within each cell, in/out share the same amplitude, profile, onset, duration, process-noise path, observation-noise path, and analysis window
intervention_contract.pair_label_randomization: for each seed, a deterministic hash bit may swap P1<->P2 jointly for in/out artifact labels only; inside/outside class is never swapped and physical target vectors are not changed

primary_distance.pooled_scale: S_pool = 1/(n+m)^2 * sum_ab ||Za-Zb|| over pooled Z=[X;Y], including zero diagonals
primary_distance.cell_aggregation: D_boundary(kappa)=median of the 16 ED_norm cell values
primary_distance.median_even_rule: arithmetic mean of the 8th and 9th sorted values

dynamic_range_gate.response_rms: for each seed/cell/side/kappa, RMS of paired do-minus-sham post-signature in observation space
dynamic_range_gate.pass: at least 95% of seed-level responses in every registered cell/side/kappa lie within [0.01,2.0], and all values are finite

flattening_empirical_crosscheck.tau_return: first t>=1 satisfying return_threshold; right-censor at 129 if absent
flattening_empirical_crosscheck.role: secondary manipulation crosscheck; analytic F_flat is the primary flattening certificate

exact_null.name: M_NULL_IDENTICAL_ACTUATION
exact_null.rule: for each matched pair replace both in_target and out_target by (in_target+out_target)/sqrt(2), while preserving the in/out labels and using matched nuisance streams
exact_null.expected: paired signatures are identical up to deterministic floating-point tolerance; ED_norm <= 1e-12 at every kappa/cell

paired_label_swap_null.rule: within each seed and cell independently swap the in/out signature labels according to a deterministic SHA256 bit; preserve group sizes by paired swapping

counterworld_control.name: CW1_DECOUPLED_REPORTER
counterworld_control.purpose: negative-control DGP showing that registered restoring flattening need not mechanically force the estimator to report boundary degeneration
counterworld_control.base_state: same 4D x dynamics, same F/R/K, same kappa grid and same x-process noise
counterworld_control.reporter_drive: for P1, s_t=[+u_t,0] for inside and [-u_t,0] for outside; for P2, s_t=[0,+u_t] for inside and [0,-u_t] for outside
counterworld_control.expected_semantics: F_flat still follows 0.20+0.80*kappa, while a kappa-independent reporter may preserve D_boundary
counterworld_control.decision_semantics: CW1 is a falsifier of any universal 'flattening implies boundary degeneration' generalization and a pipeline negative control; it does not by itself decide the base-DGP H1_TREND
counterworld_control.anti_rescue: if the pipeline forces a strong decreasing trend in CW1, implementation/estimator qualification fails; do not retune after inspection

oracle_clone.name: M_ORACLE_DUPLICATED_LATENT
oracle_clone.construction: z=(x_a,x_b), x_a(0)=x_b(0)=x_0; both copies receive the same A_kappa, same intervention, and exactly the same eta_t; y=C(theta)*(x_a+x_b)/2+xi
oracle_clone.equivalence: x_a=x_b for every t, so allowed outputs are exactly access-equivalent to the 4D base model up to replay tolerance
oracle_clone.firewall: different latent implementation dimension cannot be upgraded to a uniquely identified latent boundary mechanism

window_surface.B_eff: recompute D_boundary using only the first DeltaT post-intervention observations, with the same baseline and signature normalization sqrt(2*DeltaT)
window_surface.chi_B: absolute finite difference with respect to log(DeltaT); centered for interior grid points and one-sided at endpoints
window_surface.chi_kappa: absolute finite difference with respect to kappa; centered for interior kappa points and one-sided at endpoints

seed_namespace.matched_noise_rule: stream_name PROCESS and OBS exclude in/out side, so the matched in/out cell uses the same nuisance path
seed_namespace.no_legacy_overlap_semantics: namespace is disjoint by construction from prior PH namespaces

rng_contract.uniform64: for counter q>=0, d=SHA256(key || UTF8('|q='+q)); U=(int.from_bytes(d[0:8],'big')+0.5)/2^64
rng_contract.gaussian: consume uniforms in ordered pairs (U1,U2); Z0=sqrt(-2 ln U1) cos(2*pi U2), Z1=sqrt(-2 ln U1) sin(2*pi U2); consume Z0 then Z1
rng_contract.uniform_integer_for_bootstrap: use 64-bit hash words with rejection above floor(2^64/N)*N; accepted value mod N
rng_contract.prohibition: no library RNG may replace this stream in qualification or confirmatory execution

bootstrap_contract.paired_resampling: one resampled seed index simultaneously selects all kappa/cells/sides for that bootstrap draw
bootstrap_contract.quantile_rule: nearest-rank empirical quantile: sort B values ascending; q_p=value at 1-based index ceil(p*B)

allowed_now: write simulator and estimator code exactly from this contract
prohibited_now: change thresholds after seeing any Phase 2B outcome
